Bill.BriefDescription: Revising provisions relating to the renewal of a cosmetology, barber, or manicurist license.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the renewal of a cosmetology, barber, ormanicurist license; and amending RCW 18.16.110.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.16.110 and 2002 c 111 s 8 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The director shall issue the appropriate license to anyapplicant who meets the requirements as outlined in this chapter. (2) Failure to renew a license ((before)) by its expiration datesubjects the holder to a penalty fee and payment of each year's renewalfee, at the current rate. A person whose license has not been renewedwithin one year after its expiration date ((shall have the licensecanceled and)) shall be required to submit an application, pay thelicense fee for the current year, pay a penalty fee equal to a year'slicense fee, and meet current licensing requirements((, and pass anyapplicable examination or examinations,)) in addition to the otherrequirements of this chapter, before the license may be reinstated. (3) Upon request and payment of an additional fee to be established p. 1 SB 6426by rule by the director, the director shall issue a duplicate licenseto an applicant.
